title: Working the timbers
summary: Nephi and those who go with him work timbers for the ship.

explicit_facts.text: They worship the Lord and go forth with Nephi.
They work timbers of curious workmanship; Nephi builds according to what the Lord has shown him rather than the manner learned by men.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Timbers being worked can be shown.
unspecified_visual_details: The workers' tools and clothing are not specified.

narration.text: we did work timbers of curious workmanship.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Lord's guidance is reported; no visible appearance is described.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Lord appearing or specify an unrecorded ship design.

title: Prayer on the mount
summary: Nephi goes into the mount and prays.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi goes into the mount often and prays often; the Lord shows him great things.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi can be shown praying on the mount.
unspecified_visual_details: The mount's appearance and the content of what Nephi is shown are not specified.

narration.text: I did pray oft unto the Lord;

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse does not describe a visible revelation.
prohibited_inventions: Do not visualize the unspecified great things or a divine figure.

title: The finished ship
summary: Nephi finishes the ship. His brethren behold its workmanship and humble themselves before the Lord.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi finishes the ship according to the word of the Lord.
His brethren behold that it is good and its workmanship exceedingly fine, then humble themselves before the Lord.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The finished ship and Nephi's brethren looking at it can be shown.
unspecified_visual_details: The ship's shape and the brethren's precise gestures are not specified.

narration.text: the workmanship thereof was exceedingly fine;

prohibited_inventions: Do not assign the ship a specific construction style.

title: The command to board
summary: The voice of the Lord comes to Lehi, directing the group to go down into the ship.

explicit_facts.text: The voice of the Lord comes to Nephi's father, directing them to arise and go down into the ship.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Lehi can be shown receiving the command.
unspecified_visual_details: Lehi's exact position and surroundings are not specified.

narration.text: the voice of the Lord came unto my father

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The voice is reported without quoted words or a described visible speaker.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent the voice's exact dialogue or depict the Lord's appearance.

title: Boarding with provisions
summary: On the morrow, the group boards the ship with provisions, seeds, wives, and children.
characters: other members of the traveling group

explicit_facts.text: The group takes fruits, meat, honey, provisions, seeds, and other things down into the ship.
They board with their wives and children.
Lehi's two sons born in the wilderness are Jacob, the elder, and Joseph, the younger.

reasonable_visual_inferences: People can be shown carrying provisions onto the ship.
unspecified_visual_details: The number and ages of children other than Jacob and Joseph are not specified.

narration.text: we did all go down into the ship, with our wives and our children.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Verse 7 supplies family information, not a separate birth event at this time.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Jacob's or Joseph's birth during boarding.

title: Putting forth
summary: With everyone and the provisions aboard, the ship puts forth into the sea and is driven by the wind toward the promised land.
characters: other members of the traveling group

explicit_facts.text: The group puts forth into the sea and is driven by the wind toward the promised land.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The ship can be shown moving over the sea.
unspecified_visual_details: The ship's rigging and the coastline's appearance are not specified.

narration.text: we did put forth into the sea

prohibited_inventions: Do not show arrival at the promised land yet.

title: Merriment at sea
summary: After many days at sea, Nephi's brethren, the sons of Ishmael, and their wives dance, sing, and speak rudely. Nephi speaks soberly to them, and they answer angrily.
characters: the wives of Nephi's brethren and the sons of Ishmael

explicit_facts.text: Nephi's brethren, the sons of Ishmael, and their wives begin to dance, sing, and speak with much rudeness.
Nephi speaks to them with much soberness, and they respond angrily.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The dancing group and Nephi addressing them can share the shipboard moment.
unspecified_visual_details: The song, dance movements, and Nephi's unquoted words are not specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: We will not that our younger brother shall be a ruler over us.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi's brethren

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Nephi's feared destruction is not an event to depict here.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent lyrics or Nephi's admonition.

title: Nephi bound
summary: Laman and Lemuel bind Nephi with cords. After he is bound, the compass ceases to work.

explicit_facts.text: Laman and Lemuel take Nephi and bind him with cords, treating him harshly.
After Nephi is bound so that he cannot move, the compass ceases to work.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Cords restraining Nephi can be shown.
unspecified_visual_details: The compass's mechanism and the manner of harsh treatment are not specified.

narration.text: Laman and Lemuel did take me and bind me with cords

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse reports a divine purpose but no visible divine appearance.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent additional violence or a visual effect for the compass.

title: Driven back by the storm
summary: A great storm drives the ship back for three days. On the fourth day the tempest grows worse, while Nephi remains bound.

explicit_facts.text: The group does not know where to steer; a great tempest drives the ship back for three days, and they fear drowning.
They do not loose Nephi, and on the fourth day the tempest becomes exceedingly sore.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Rough seas and Nephi still bound can be shown.
unspecified_visual_details: The storm's exact appearance and the ship's course are not specified.

narration.text: the tempest began to be exceedingly sore.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Three days and the fourth day are successive times, not one simultaneous image.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show the ship sinking or Nephi being freed yet.

title: Grief aboard the ship
summary: While Nephi remains bound during the ordeal, Lehi and Sariah suffer grief, Jacob and Joseph grieve, and Nephi's wife weeps and prays. Nephi praises God despite his afflictions.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi praises God and does not murmur because of his afflictions.
Lehi has spoken to the others; he and Nephi's mother are brought down upon sick-beds by grief.
Jacob and Joseph grieve over their mother's afflictions, and Nephi's wife has tears and prayers; these do not persuade his brethren to loose him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The family's distress can be shown aboard while Nephi remains bound.
unspecified_visual_details: The sick-beds' form and the positions of family members are not specified.

narration.text: my wife with her tears and prayers

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Lehi's earlier words and the threats are reported without quotations; the watery-grave language expresses danger, not a burial event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent Lehi's speech, the wife's prayer, or anyone's death.

title: The bands loosed
summary: After four days of being driven back, Nephi's brethren recognize their danger, repent, and loose the bands upon him.

explicit_facts.text: After four days of being driven back, Nephi's brethren come to him and loose the bands on his wrists.
His wrists and ankles are swollen and sore.
His brethren repent of what they have done and loose him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The removal of the cords can be shown without focusing on injury.
unspecified_visual_details: Which brother removes each cord is not specified.

narration.text: they came unto me, and loosed the bands which were upon my wrist

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Verses 15 and 20 describe the same release, not two releases.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict gore or a second freeing of Nephi.

title: Compass and calm
summary: After his release, Nephi takes the compass, prays, and the winds and storm cease.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi takes the compass, and it works as he desires.
Nephi prays; afterward the winds and storm cease and there is a great calm.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi can be shown holding the compass against a calm sea after prayer.
unspecified_visual_details: The compass's design and Nephi's prayer words are not specified.

narration.text: the storm did cease, and there was a great calm.

prohibited_inventions: Do not invent Nephi's prayer or a visible divine figure.

title: Sailing onward
summary: Nephi guides the ship as it sails again toward the promised land.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi guides the ship, and they sail again toward the promised land.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi can be shown attending to the ship's direction.
unspecified_visual_details: The means of steering is not specified.

narration.text: I, Nephi, did guide the ship

prohibited_inventions: Do not add a specified steering device.

title: Arrival and tents
summary: After many days of sailing, the group arrives at the promised land, goes ashore, and pitches tents.
characters: other members of the traveling group

explicit_facts.text: The group arrives at the promised land after many days of sailing, goes forth upon it, and pitches tents.
They call it the promised land.

reasonable_visual_inferences: People and pitched tents can be shown on the land.
unspecified_visual_details: The shore, terrain, and tents' construction are not specified.

narration.text: we went forth upon the land, and did pitch our tents;

prohibited_inventions: Do not invent a landing ceremony or dialogue naming the land.

title: Planting seeds
summary: The group tills the earth and plants the seeds brought from the land of Jerusalem.

explicit_facts.text: The group begins to till the earth and plants all the seeds brought from the land of Jerusalem.
The seeds grow exceedingly, and the group is blessed in abundance.

reasonable_visual_inferences: People placing seeds in tilled earth can be shown.
unspecified_visual_details: The crops and farming tools are not identified.

narration.text: we did put all our seeds into the earth

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The later growth is reported, not simultaneous with planting.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show fully grown crops in the planting moment.

title: Finds in the land
summary: While journeying in the wilderness of the land of promise, the group finds animals in the forests and finds gold, silver, and copper ore.

explicit_facts.text: As the group journeys in the wilderness, they find animals in the forests, including cows, oxen, asses, horses, goats, and wild goats.
They also find gold, silver, and copper ore.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Travelers observing animals in the forest can be shown.
unspecified_visual_details: The animals' arrangement and the ore deposits' appearance are not specified.

narration.text: we did find all manner of ore, both of gold, and of silver, and of copper.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The finds are reported as occurring during the journey; they need not all appear in one place.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add hunting, mining, or an ore-processing event.
